---
title: "PairLoom next & recommendation"
author: "Yun Jiang"
---

## next

1. M: extend candidate discovery to slide gapped (indel-bearing) alignments via bounded local realignment, removing the documented exact-block-only limitation.
2. M: add a `--merge-stats-parquet` optional output with overlap-length distributions and merge-rejection reason counts while keeping the required read-stats schema unchanged.
3. L: profile and optimize the per-template SAM-string serialization in the single-process path (candidates: record round-trip and to_string/fromstring).
4. L: add a GitHub Actions workflow (pixi-based test matrix, ruff, benchmark smoke) with Dependabot.

## recommendation

1. M: treat `stats.parquet` disagreement reasons as pipeline telemetry — surface the stderr merge-reason summary in downstream QC reports.
2. L: before relying on `--force-mapq60-exact`, quantify the repeat content of the target reference; the compat flag overstates confidence by design.
3. L: for very large cohorts, prefer `--threads 4` with `--chunk-size 256`; measured scaling flattens beyond four workers in the current benchmark.
